title: Not just Neanderthals: Ghost lineage in Africa left its mark on our DNA
summary: Given about 500 modern human genomes, TRACE pulled out the expected Neanderthal and Denisovan segments. The modern human genome has areas, called “deserts,” that lack Neanderthal and Denisovan DNA entirely.
